Research Associate II: M.E/ M.Tech having 3 years of research experience with at least one research paper in SCI/ SCIE Journal (with specialization of RF & Microwave Engineering or Signal Processing or communication systems or allied fields). Research Associate III: Please refer to the official notification for eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Uttarakhand Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Uttarakhand to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow/Research Associate positions at NIT Uttarakhand is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NIT Uttarakhand?
faq.answer: NIT Uttarakhand has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow/Research Associate positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow post, candidates need to have an M.E/M.Tech./M.S in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied fields, with a minimum of 1st class in B.E/B.Tech & M.E/M.Tech, and a mandatory GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is preferably below 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate - III position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate - III position is Rs. 67,000/- pm + HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview conducted in a hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NIT Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the NIT Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the walk-in interview date for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the recruitment will be held on 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Committee Room (C106), Department of Electronics Engineering, NIT Uttarakhand, Srinagar Campus, Srinagar Garhwal - 246174.

faq.question: Q10. What is the project for which these positions are being recruited?
faq.answer: These positions are being recruited for the project titled 'Advanced Electromagnetic Solutions for Enhanced Wireless Connectivity in Complex Terrains Using Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces and OAM-Based Radiating Structures'.
